Video series: 7 minutes to understand AI
Green Digital Transformation   We foster global collaboration to make AI more sustainable, inclusive, and resilient for everyone.

Digital transformation   We promote a human-centered digital transformation, wherein AI, data, and open solutions build capacity, foster inclusion, protect diversity, and drive sustainable, rights-based innovation.

Quantum computing   We are helping the world prepare for the quantum revolution, wherein quantum mechanics helps solve problems too complex for today’s computers, in areas like medicine, encryption, and materials science.

Neurotechnology   We are developing ethical frameworks to ensure these technologies fulfill their promise in health while upholding equity, mental privacy, freedom of thought, and protection of the most vulnerable.

Natural science   We leverage AI to advance innovative, science-based solutions for sustainable development – from managing water and biodiversity to reducing disaster risks and strengthening climate resilience.

Information integrity   Algorithms and generative AI are reshaping how people access and trust information, with major effects on journalism, expression, and rights. We foster media literacy and inform digital platform governance.

Culture   As AI transforms how culture is created, accessed, managed, and experienced, UNESCO works to ensure AI’s development and use protect and promote cultural diversity, creativity, and access for all.
Gender   New technologies risk widening gender gaps, especially when AI learns from biased data. UNESCO’s work on AI and gender guides policymakers and innovators to close these divides.

Education   We convene leaders, experts, and innovators to address the impact of AI and technology in education, promoting human-centered, inclusive, and equitable approaches to the benefit of all learners.

Recommendation on the Ethics of Neurotechnology   The 2025 UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Neurotechnology sets global principles to ensure neurotechnology is developed and used in ways that respect human rights, dignity, and societal well-being.

Recommendation on the Ethics of AI   In 2021, UNESCO adopted the Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence, guiding its work and helping Member States develop ethically aligned AI policies and capacities.
Readiness Assessment Methodology
Technology Policy Assistance Facility

G20 Technology Policy Assistance Facility   A G20-backed platform that helps policymakers and stakeholders research, design, and implement ethical, inclusive, and future-ready technology and AI policies.
Global AI Ethics and Governance Observatory   The Observatory supports global stakeholders in promoting ethical and responsible AI through research, tools, and best practices.

Readiness Assessment Methodology (RAM)   The RAM program helps governments identify and address gaps in their AI policies, strategies, and legislation, so that AI is deployed ethically and responsibly to the benefit of their their citizens.
Internet Universality Indicators   This tool helps countries assess their Internet landscape, guide evidence-based policies, and foster inclusive, future-ready digital governance.
